traditional-gold.name: Traditional Gold
traditional-gold.description: A kolam draws itself on granite and the temple bell rings open your invitation — temple gold, jasmine and lamp light throughout.

minimal-modern.name: Minimal Modern
minimal-modern.description: A single hairline splits the page to reveal your names — generous whitespace, big confident type, and nothing more.

floral-pastel.name: Floral Pastel
floral-pastel.description: A peony bud blooms open and butterflies fly out — soft blush and sage, with a vine that grows as guests scroll.

elegant-bw.name: Elegant Black & White
elegant-bw.description: Guests pull a satin ribbon to open a black gift box and lift out a silver card — monochrome, theatrical, timeless.

beach-boho.name: Beach Boho
beach-boho.description: A message in a bottle washes ashore and a wave reveals your invitation — the sky turns from noon to sunset as guests scroll.

anniversary-emerald.name: Emerald Anniversary
anniversary-emerald.description: Rich emerald and gold for celebrating another year of a lasting love.

valentine-blush.name: Blush Valentine
valentine-blush.description: Warm reds and soft blush for a sweet, romantic Valentine's Day note.

proposal-starlit.name: Starlit Proposal
proposal-starlit.description: A midnight-blue, starlit scene for announcing the moment someone said yes.

birthday-confetti.name: Confetti Birthday
birthday-confetti.description: Bold color and confetti for a birthday party invite that isn't shy about it.

housewarming-terracotta.name: Terracotta House Warming
housewarming-terracotta.description: Earthy terracotta and greenery for welcoming friends to your new home.

silk-curtain.name: Silk Curtain
silk-curtain.description: Guests pull a gold tassel and silk stage curtains sweep open on your names, with gold dust in the footlights.

scratch-reveal.name: Scratch & Reveal
scratch-reveal.description: Guests scratch a rose-gold foil card to uncover your date — confetti bursts the moment it's revealed.

lantern-night.name: Lantern Night
lantern-night.description: Guests light a clay lamp and a wave of glowing lanterns rises into the night sky — a Karthigai Deepam feel.

thoranam-jasmine.name: Thoranam & Jasmine
thoranam-jasmine.description: A Tamil wedding doorway: a mango-leaf thoranam swings in and strings of jasmine part as kolam dots bloom.

kerala-kasavu.name: Kasavu & Nilavilakku
kerala-kasavu.description: A kasavu cloth unrolls and the brass nilavilakku lights wick by wick — a Kerala temple wedding.

pookalam.name: Pookalam
pookalam.description: An Onam pookalam is laid ring by ring — marigold, chethi, thumba — then opens onto your invitation.

grand-reception.name: Grand Reception
grand-reception.description: A cinematic reception opening: spotlights sweep the stage and a marquee of bulbs lights up your names with gold confetti.

engagement-ring.name: Ring Box
engagement-ring.description: A velvet ring box on blush satin — one tap opens the lid, the ring rises in a sparkle and your names appear.

baby-moon.name: Moon Cradle
baby-moon.description: A crescent-moon cradle and a mobile of stars on a pastel dusk — tap the moon to rock it and send bubbles floating up.

corporate-ticket.name: Event Pass
corporate-ticket.description: A clean event pass on a midnight grid — guests tear off the "Admit one" stub to open your invitation, with RSVP built in.

traditional-gold.story: Priya and Arjun met at a college reunion in Chennai and knew almost instantly that they'd found their person. Six years, countless train journeys between cities, and one very persistent proposal later, they're ready to begin the next chapter — surrounded by the families who raised them and the friends who never doubted it. We'd be honored to have you there as we tie the knot the traditional way, with all the rituals, music, and mounds of food that make a South Indian wedding what it is.

faq.question: What's the dress code?
faq.answer: Traditional Indian attire is encouraged — silk sarees, lehengas, and kurtas in festive colors.

faq.question: Is parking available?
faq.answer: Yes, valet parking is available at the venue entrance.

places.title: Kapaleeshwarar Temple
places.description: The 7th-century Shiva temple at the heart of Mylapore, with a towering painted gopuram.

places.title: Marina Beach
places.description: One of the world's longest urban beaches — perfect for an evening stroll and sundal.

places.title: Fort St. George
places.description: India's first British fortress, now home to a museum of colonial-era history.

places.title: Government Museum
places.description: Bronze galleries with some of the finest Chola-era sculpture anywhere.

minimal-modern.story: Meera and Rohan met on a rainy Tuesday, arguing over the last seat at a coffee shop. Neither of them remembers who won. What started as an accidental conversation turned into five years of building a life together — through new cities, new jobs, and a shared love of terrible puns. Now they're making it official, and they'd love for you to be part of the day.

faq.question: What should I wear?
faq.answer: Smart casual to semi-formal — no strict dress code, just come comfortable.

faq.question: Are kids welcome?
faq.answer: Absolutely — this is a family-friendly celebration.

places.title: Bangalore Palace
places.description: A Tudor-style palace with turrets, carved wood interiors and royal portraits.

places.title: Lalbagh Botanical Garden
places.description: 240 acres of old trees, a glass house and a 3,000-million-year-old rock.

places.title: Cubbon Park
places.description: Shaded walking paths right in the middle of the city.

places.title: ISKCON Temple
places.description: A hilltop temple complex, lovely in the evening lights.

floral-pastel.story: Ananya and Kabir's story began with a shared plant obsession and a balcony full of dying succulents. Somewhere between learning how to keep a fern alive and planning weekend hikes, they fell in love. This February, under strings of fairy lights and more flowers than either of them can name, they're saying 'I do' — and they can't imagine the day without you in it.

faq.question: What's the dress code?
faq.answer: Garden party attire — pastels and florals are very welcome.

faq.question: Will the ceremony be outdoors?
faq.answer: Yes, weather permitting — we'll have a backup indoor space just in case.

places.title: Lalbagh Botanical Garden
places.description: Famous for its flower shows, glass house and centuries-old trees.

places.title: Bangalore Palace
places.description: Tudor-style towers and royal interiors, a short drive into town.

places.title: Varthur Lake
places.description: A quiet lakeside for early-morning birdwatching.

places.title: ISKCON Temple
places.description: A hilltop temple complex, beautiful at dusk.

elegant-bw.story: Naina and Vikram met at a mutual friend's wedding and spent the entire reception talking instead of dancing — which, in hindsight, said everything. Three years on, they're ready for a wedding of their own. Join us for an evening of quiet elegance, old favorites, and the beginning of forever.

faq.question: What's the dress code?
faq.answer: Black tie optional — think classic evening wear.

faq.question: Is there a gift registry?
faq.answer: Your presence is the only present we need.

places.title: Humayun's Tomb
places.description: The garden tomb that inspired the Taj Mahal, calm and symmetrical.

places.title: Qutub Minar
places.description: A 73-metre victory tower of carved red sandstone from 1193.

places.title: Lodhi Garden
places.description: 15th-century tombs set among lawns — Delhi's favourite morning walk.

places.title: Akshardham
places.description: An intricately carved temple complex with an evening water show.

beach-boho.story: Diya and Aryan fell in love on a backpacking trip through Goa, somewhere between a sunset and a plate of prawn curry. Barefoot on the sand felt like the only honest place to start forever, so that's exactly where they're getting married. Pack light, bring your dancing shoes, and come celebrate with us by the sea.

faq.question: What should I wear?
faq.answer: Light, breezy fabrics — it's a beach, so skip the heels.

faq.question: Is there parking nearby?
faq.answer: Limited parking at the venue — we recommend carpooling or a cab.

places.title: Morjim Beach
places.description: Soft sand and olive ridley turtles, just down the coast.

places.title: Chapora Fort
places.description: Laterite ramparts with sweeping views over the river mouth.

places.title: Basilica of Bom Jesus
places.description: A 16th-century baroque church in Old Goa, a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

places.title: Mapusa Friday Market
places.description: Spices, cashews and local sausages at North Goa's busiest market.

anniversary-emerald.story: Twenty-five years ago, Meena and Suresh promised each other a lifetime — and somehow, between raising a family, moving three cities, and never quite agreeing on the thermostat, they've kept it. This December, they'd love for the people who've been part of that story to raise a glass with them and celebrate a quarter-century of choosing each other, again and again.

faq.question: Should I bring a gift?
faq.answer: Just your company — but if you insist, a bottle of wine never hurts.

faq.question: What's the dress code?
faq.answer: Smart casual — come as you are.

valentine-blush.story: No grand speeches, no big reveal — just the two of us, a table for two, and every reason to celebrate another year of picking each other. Happy Valentine's Day. Here's to us.

faq.question: Do I need to RSVP?
faq.answer: Just show up looking cute — that's the only RSVP I need.

faq.question: What should I wear?
faq.answer: Whatever makes you feel good. I'm not picky.

proposal-starlit.story: Meher, from that first terrible cup of coffee we both pretended to like, I knew I wanted a lifetime of terrible coffee with you. Every plan I make these days has your name written into it, whether you know it or not. So here's one more: meet me at Nandi Hills at sunset. I have a question for you.

faq.question: What should I wear?
faq.answer: Something you love — comfortable shoes recommended for the walk up.

faq.question: Anything I should know?
faq.answer: Just trust me and show up. That's all I ask.

birthday-confetti.story: Happy birthday, Zara! Another trip around the sun and you're still the most fun person we know — the one who somehow makes every plan better just by showing up. Hope your day is full of cake, terrible karaoke, and everyone who loves you. Can't wait to celebrate with you.

faq.question: What should I bring?
faq.answer: Just yourself — and maybe your best dance moves.

faq.question: Is there a dress code?
faq.answer: Come as you are — casual and fun.

housewarming-terracotta.story: After a year of boxes, paint swatches, and way too many trips to the hardware store, our new home is finally starting to feel like one. We'd love for you to be the first to see it — come by for snacks, a house tour, and (hopefully) working Wi-Fi.

faq.question: Should I bring anything?
faq.answer: Just yourself! If you want to bring something, a plant for the new place would be lovely.

faq.question: Is there parking?
faq.answer: Street parking is available — please be mindful of our neighbors.

silk-curtain.story: Lakshmi and Karthik first met backstage at a college Bharatanatyam recital — she was the lead dancer, he was the nervous student running the lights. He missed her cue, she laughed it off, and they spent the rest of the evening talking in the wings. Years of music seasons, temple festivals and long evening walks later, the curtain rises on their own grand performance — and they would love for you to have a front-row seat.

faq.question: What's the dress code?
faq.answer: Traditional festive wear — silks in rich jewel tones are perfect.

faq.question: Is there parking at the venue?
faq.answer: Yes, parking is available inside the mahal campus.

places.title: Meenakshi Amman Temple
places.description: The great temple at the heart of Madurai, with towering painted gopurams and the Hall of a Thousand Pillars.

places.title: Thirumalai Nayakkar Mahal
places.description: A 17th-century palace of giant pillars and arches, with a sound-and-light show in the evenings.

scratch-reveal.story: Nila and Aditya's first date was a lucky-draw stall at a college fest — she scratched a card and won a teddy bear, he scratched his and won nothing, and she insisted on sharing the prize. Some luck, it turns out, is worth waiting for. Three years later they have the only prize that matters, and they can't wait to celebrate it with you.

faq.question: What should I wear?
faq.answer: Pastels are very welcome — think lilac, blush and soft gold.

faq.question: Are children welcome?
faq.answer: Absolutely — there's a little play corner for the young ones.

places.title: Marudhamalai Temple
places.description: A hilltop Murugan temple with sweeping views over the city and the Western Ghats.

places.title: Kovai Kutralam Falls
places.description: A forest waterfall in the Siruvani hills — a short trek through the trees and a cool mist at the end.

lantern-night.story: Deepa and Surya met on a Karthigai Deepam night, both climbing the steps to watch the great flame light up on the hill. Somewhere between the crowd, the chanting and a shared cup of sukku coffee, a small light began that neither of them could put out. Now, with the blessings of both families, they begin their life together in the town where it all began.

faq.question: What's the dress code?
faq.answer: Traditional wear in warm festive colours — saffron, gold and deep red.

faq.question: Why is the ceremony so early?
faq.answer: The muhurtham is at dawn; breakfast is served right after the ceremony.

places.title: Arunachaleswarar Temple
places.description: One of the largest temples in India, at the foot of the sacred Arunachala hill.

places.title: Sri Ramana Ashram
places.description: A peaceful ashram with shaded courtyards, peacocks and paths up the hill.

thoranam-jasmine.story: Meenakshi and Senthil grew up two streets apart in Thanjavur, meeting every year at the temple festival without ever really noticing each other. When their families finally introduced them properly, they discovered a shared love of Carnatic music, filter coffee and long walks around the Big Temple. With mango leaves on the doorway and jasmine in the air, they invite you to bless them as they begin their journey together.

faq.question: What's the dress code?
faq.answer: Traditional Tamil attire — veshti and silk sarees are warmly encouraged.

faq.question: Will lunch be served?
faq.answer: Yes — a traditional feast on banana leaves right after the muhurtham.

places.title: Brihadeeswarar Temple
places.description: The Big Temple — a thousand-year-old Chola masterpiece and a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

places.title: Thanjavur Maratha Palace
places.description: A royal palace complex with an art gallery of Chola bronzes and the Saraswathi Mahal library.

kerala-kasavu.story: Anjali and Arun met at a Kathakali performance during the Thrissur Pooram season — she was explaining the mudras to her cousins, and he quietly admitted he had been following along too. A friendship grew over boat rides, banana chips and long debates about the best sadya. With the blessings of Guruvayurappan and both families, they tie the knot the Kerala way, and your presence would make the day complete.

faq.question: What's the dress code?
faq.answer: Kerala traditional — kasavu sarees, set-mundu and mundu are perfect.

faq.question: Is there a sadya after the ceremony?
faq.answer: Yes — a full traditional sadya is served at the reception venue.

places.title: Guruvayur Sri Krishna Temple
places.description: One of Kerala's most loved temples, where hundreds of weddings take place on auspicious days.

places.title: Athirappilly Falls
places.description: Kerala's grandest waterfall, dropping through dense forest — a beautiful drive from Thrissur.

pookalam.story: Gauri and Vishnu's families have laid the Onam pookalam side by side in the same courtyard for as long as either of them can remember. Every year they competed to make the brighter one, and every year the neighbours declared a tie. This Onam season they finally stopped competing and started planning — one pookalam, one family, and a wedding they would love to share with you.

faq.question: What should I wear?
faq.answer: Onam colours — cream, gold and a touch of green or red.

faq.question: Will there be an Onam sadya?
faq.answer: Of course — a full sadya with payasam, served on banana leaves.

places.title: Chinese Fishing Nets, Fort Kochi
places.description: The giant cantilevered nets along the Fort Kochi shore — magical at sunset.

places.title: Mattancherry Palace
places.description: The Dutch Palace, with some of Kerala's finest temple murals of the Ramayana.

grand-reception.story: Two families, one stage and a night full of music. After the wedding in the morning, we would love for you to join us for our grand reception — lights, dinner and dancing as we begin our life together.

faq.question: What's the dress code?
faq.answer: Evening festive wear — sequins and silks are very welcome.

faq.question: Is there valet parking?
faq.answer: Yes, valet parking is available at the convention centre.

places.title: Marina Beach
places.description: One of the longest urban beaches in the world — perfect for an evening walk and sundal.

places.title: Kapaleeshwarar Temple
places.description: A Dravidian temple in Mylapore with a colourful gopuram and a peaceful temple tank.

engagement-ring.story: With the blessings of our elders, Divya and Karthik will exchange rings and promise to walk the next chapter together. Please join us for the ring ceremony and dinner.

faq.question: What's the dress code?
faq.answer: Traditional or festive wear.

faq.question: Will lunch be served?
faq.answer: Yes — lunch after the ceremony, and dinner in the evening.

baby-moon.story: A little one is on the way, and our hearts are full. Come and celebrate Meera with bangles, blessings, games and good food as we get ready to welcome the newest member of our family.

faq.question: Should I bring a gift?
faq.answer: Your blessings are the best gift — but if you'd like, the family has a small wish list.

faq.question: Is it okay to bring children?
faq.answer: Of course — little ones are very welcome.

corporate-ticket.story: Join Nova Tech for the launch of our newest platform — a morning of keynotes and live demos, followed by an evening of networking and dinner with our team and partners.

faq.question: Is registration required?
faq.answer: Yes — please RSVP below so we can prepare your pass.

faq.question: Is there parking?
faq.answer: Free parking is available in the convention centre basement.

errorBoundary.heading: Something went wrong
errorBoundary.body: An unexpected error occurred. You can try again, or head back home.

collegeSweethearts.title: College sweethearts
collegeSweethearts.text: {a} and {b} first met in a crowded college canteen, arguing over the last samosa. What began as a friendly rivalry turned into late-night study sessions, long walks after exams and a friendship neither of them could do without. Years later, they are ready to turn that campus love story into a lifetime together — and they would love for you to be there as it begins.

childhoodFriends.title: Childhood friends
childhoodFriends.text: {a} and {b} grew up on the same street, sharing lunch boxes, bicycle rides and every festival in between. Their families always joked that the two were inseparable — no one imagined how right they were. After a lifetime of friendship, they are finally making it official, and they want the people who watched them grow up to be right there with them.

loveArranged.title: Love-cum-arranged
loveArranged.text: When their families first arranged for {a} and {b} to meet, both of them expected a polite cup of coffee and nothing more. Instead, one conversation stretched into hours, and a few meetings became a friendship that felt like it had always been there. With the blessings of both families and two hearts that chose each other, they now begin their journey together.

matrimony.title: Matched online
matrimony.text: It started with a profile, a hesitant first message and a phone call that lasted far longer than planned. {a} and {b} discovered they laughed at the same jokes, dreamed of the same places and valued the same things. What began on a screen grew into something wonderfully real, and now they are ready to say yes to forever.

colleagues.title: Met at work
colleagues.text: {a} and {b} met on their first day at the same office, both lost and looking for the right meeting room. Shared deadlines became shared lunches, and shared lunches became the best part of every day. Somewhere between the coffee breaks and the long projects, they found the partner they had been looking for.

longDistance.title: Long distance
longDistance.text: For years, {a} and {b} loved each other across cities, time zones and countless video calls. They counted down the days between visits and learned that distance only made their bond stronger. Now the waiting is finally over — they are closing the miles for good and would love to celebrate with you.

friendsWedding.title: Met at a wedding
friendsWedding.text: {a} and {b} met at a friend’s wedding, seated at the same table and laughing through every speech. They spent the evening talking instead of dancing and left with each other’s numbers and a feeling they could not shake. Today the guests have become the couple, and it is their turn to invite you to celebrate.

traditionalBlessing.title: Traditional blessing
traditionalBlessing.text: With the blessings of the Almighty and the grace of our elders, we joyfully announce the wedding of {a} and {b}. Two families come together in love and respect, bound by tradition and the hope of a bright future. Your presence and blessings on this auspicious day will make our celebration complete.

firstYear.title: First anniversary
firstYear.text: One year ago, {a} and {b} said yes to a lifetime together. It has been a year of new beginnings, small adventures, burnt dinners and endless laughter. Join us as we raise a toast to the first of many years to come.

silverJubilee.title: 25 years together
silverJubilee.text: Twenty-five years ago, {a} and {b} began a journey filled with love, patience and countless shared moments. Through a growing family, new homes and every season of life, they have stood by each other. Come celebrate their silver jubilee with the people who have been part of their story.

goldenJubilee.title: 50 golden years
goldenJubilee.text: Fifty years of love, faith and togetherness — {a} and {b} have built a family and a legacy that inspires everyone around them. Their children and grandchildren invite you to join in honouring this golden milestone. Your presence would mean the world to them.

renewal.title: Renewing our vows
renewal.text: All these years later, {a} and {b} would still choose each other every single time. So they are saying their vows once more, surrounded by the people who have cheered them on along the way. Come witness a promise that has only grown stronger with time.

simpleNote.title: A simple note
simpleNote.text: {b}, every day with you feels like a gift I never expected to receive. This Valentine’s Day, I just want a quiet evening with the person who makes my world brighter. Save the date — it’s a plan for two. — {a}

everyday.title: Everyday love
everyday.text: It’s not the grand gestures, {b} — it’s the morning chai, the silly texts and the way you always save me the last bite. Thank you for turning ordinary days into my favourite memories. Let’s celebrate us. With love, {a}

adventure.title: Our next adventure
adventure.text: {b}, you’re my favourite travel partner, my best listener and my partner in every crazy plan. This Valentine’s Day, I’ve planned a little surprise just for you. Bring your smile and meet me there. — {a}

sunset.title: At sunset
sunset.text: {b}, from the day we met, every sunset has looked more beautiful with you beside me. I have a special evening planned and one very important question to ask. Please meet me there — I can’t wait. — {a}

sinceDayOne.title: Since day one
sinceDayOne.text: {b}, I think I knew from our very first conversation. You make me laugh, you make me braver and you make every day feel like home. I’d love to spend the rest of my life proving that to you. Will you meet me for a moment we’ll remember forever? — {a}

withFamily.title: With our families
withFamily.text: With love and the blessings of both families, {a} has a special question for {b}. Join us for a joyful evening as two hearts take their first step towards a lifetime together.

bestFriend.title: For a best friend
bestFriend.text: Happy birthday, {a}! You bring the fun, the laughter and the best stories to every gathering. Join us to celebrate the most wonderful person we know with cake, music and a whole lot of love.

firstBirthday.title: First birthday
firstBirthday.text: Our little star {a} is turning one! A year of tiny giggles, first steps and endless joy has flown by. Come celebrate this very special day with us and shower our little one with your blessings.

manivizha.title: 60th birthday (Manivizha)
manivizha.text: With great joy, we celebrate the 60th birthday of {a} — a lifetime of love, wisdom and kindness. Family and friends are warmly invited to the Manivizha celebration to offer their blessings for many more healthy, happy years.

milestone.title: Milestone birthday
milestone.text: {a} is stepping into a brand new chapter, and there’s no better reason to celebrate! Come join us for an evening of good food, great company and memories in the making.

grihaPravesam.title: Griha Pravesam
grihaPravesam.text: With the blessings of the Almighty, we warmly invite you to the Griha Pravesam of our new home. Please join us for the pooja and share in our joy as we begin this new chapter with your blessings. — {a}

casualParty.title: Housewarming party
casualParty.text: We’ve unpacked (mostly) and we’re ready to celebrate! We would love for you to come and see the new place — good food, good company and a proper house tour included. — {a}

firstHome.title: Our first home
firstHome.text: After years of dreaming and planning, we have finally found a place to call home. A home is only complete with the people who fill it with love, so please come and celebrate with us. — {a}

familiesMeet.title: When our families met
familiesMeet.text: Our families met over filter coffee and a long list of questions — and by the end of the evening, {a} and {b} were the ones who couldn't stop talking. With the blessings of our elders, we exchange rings and begin the journey to our wedding. Please join us.

loveStory.title: Our love story
loveStory.text: What began as a friendship between {a} and {b} slowly became the most important part of our lives. Now, with both our families beside us, we are making it official. Come and celebrate our engagement with us.

traditional.title: Traditional blessing
traditional.text: With the grace of the Almighty and the blessings of our families, the engagement of {a} and {b} will be celebrated with the customary rituals. We request your presence and blessings on this auspicious day.

valaikaappu.title: Valaikaappu
valaikaappu.text: With joy in our hearts, we celebrate the Valaikaappu of {a}. Bangles, blessings and good food await — please come and shower your love on the mother-to-be and the little one on the way.

babyShower.title: Baby shower
babyShower.text: A little one is on the way! Join us for an afternoon of games, cake and happy tears as we celebrate {a} before the newest member of our family arrives.

namingCeremony.title: Naming ceremony
namingCeremony.text: Our little star has arrived, and it is time to give our baby a name. Please join us for the naming ceremony of {a} and bless our child with your love.

productLaunch.title: Product launch
productLaunch.text: {a} invites you to the launch of our newest product — an evening of first looks, live demos and conversations with the team that built it. We would love to have you there.

annualDay.title: Annual day
annualDay.text: Another year of hard work, big wins and great people. {a} invites you to our Annual Day — awards, performances and dinner together as we celebrate the year gone by.

conference.title: Conference
conference.text: {a} welcomes you to a day of talks, workshops and networking with leaders across the industry. Reserve your seat and RSVP below.

support.title: How can we help?
support.intro: Answers to the most common questions, and a real person to talk to when you need one.

topics.editingBody: Use the private edit link from your publish confirmation. Keep it safe — it is the key to your invitation.
topics.guestsBody: Guests reply on the invitation. You see every response, send personal links and WhatsApp reminders from your guest list.
topics.languageBody: Edit in one language and set the invitation to another — guests always see the language you choose.
topics.paymentsBody: Payments are processed securely by Razorpay. We never see or store your card or UPI details.

faq.editLinkQ: How do I make changes after publishing?
faq.editLinkA: Right after payment we show your private edit link. Open it any time to change text, photos or the design, then press Save changes — the live invitation updates immediately.
faq.lostLinkQ: I lost my edit link. What now?
faq.lostLinkA: Contact us with your invitation link and your Razorpay payment ID. Once we confirm it is yours, we will send the edit link again.
faq.changeDesignQ: Can I switch to a different design later?
faq.changeDesignA: Yes. Use Switch design in the editor — your names, dates, story, family and photos stay; only the look changes.
faq.rsvpQ: Where do I see who is coming?
faq.rsvpA: Open your guest list (View RSVPs) from the editor or your edit link. It shows every response, guest counts and messages, and lets you send reminders.
faq.whatsappQ: How do I send the invitation on WhatsApp?
faq.whatsappA: Use Share on WhatsApp on the invitation or in your guest list. You can also create personal links that greet each guest by name.
faq.tamilQ: Can the invitation be in Tamil?
faq.tamilA: Yes. Choose தமிழ் under Invitation language in the editor. Labels, dates and suggested stories switch to Tamil, and guests see it in Tamil.
faq.photosA: Clear, well-lit photos. You can crop each one before uploading and reorder them with the arrows — the first photo becomes the cover.
faq.paymentA: Payments go through Razorpay, a PCI-DSS compliant payment gateway. Card and UPI details are entered on Razorpay's secure form and never reach our servers.

support.contactBody: Write to us with your invitation link and a short description of the problem, and we will get back to you.
support.responseTime: We usually reply within one working day.
support.privacyNote: Please don't send passwords or card details. Read how we handle your data in our <link>privacy policy</link>.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: InviteYou helps you create and share invitations. This policy explains, in plain language, what information we handle, why, and the choices you have.

collect.title: What we collect
body: Invitation content you enter: names, dates, times, venues, your story, family names, FAQs, travel details, and the photos and music you upload.
We do not ask you to create an account. Instead, each published invitation has a private edit link that only you receive.
Basic usage information: how many times an invitation was opened (a simple count, not who opened it).

guests.title: Information from your guests
body: When guests RSVP they may give their name, number of guests, whether they are coming, which side they are from, a message, and optionally a WhatsApp number for reminders.
Guest phone numbers are visible only to the invitation owner through the private guest list. They are never shown on the public invitation.
Messages from guests who accept may appear on the invitation's blessings wall. Photos guests upload appear in the shared guest gallery.

use.title: How we use information
body: To show your invitation to the people you share it with, record RSVPs, and let you manage your guest list.
To prevent abuse — for example, limiting repeated RSVP or photo submissions from the same device. For this, IP addresses are kept briefly in memory and not stored.
We do not sell your information, and we do not use it for advertising.

payments.title: Payments & refunds
body: Payments are processed by Razorpay. Your card, UPI or bank details are entered on Razorpay's secure checkout and never reach our servers.
We keep only the payment and order IDs needed to confirm your purchase and help with any issue. For refund requests, contact us with your payment ID.

storage.title: Where data is stored
body: Invitations, RSVPs and uploaded files are stored with Google Firebase (Cloud Firestore and Cloud Storage). The website is hosted on Vercel.
Published invitations and their photos can be seen by anyone who has the link — please share it only with the people you invite.
Access rules prevent anyone else from changing your invitation or replacing its photos.

device.title: Cookies & storage on your device
body: We use a small number of functional cookies and browser storage: your language and theme preference, an unsaved draft of the invitation you are creating (kept only on your device), and a note that you have already opened an invitation so its opening does not replay every visit.
We do not use advertising or tracking cookies.

yourData.title: Your choices & your data
body: You can change or remove invitation content at any time with your edit link.
To delete a published invitation with its RSVPs and photos, or to ask what information we hold, contact us from the email linked below with your invitation link.
Guests who want their RSVP, message or phone number removed can contact the couple, or write to us directly.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
body: If we change how we handle information, we will update this page and the date at the top.
